13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.visual_critic_note: Dark theme with intentional blue/orange source-target color coding and satisfying hover interaction, but at-rest the chart is dense and low-contrast — most links dissolve into the background, making the dependency structure unreadable without mousing over nodes.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.encoding_integrity_note: No quantitative encoding violations (no bars, areas, or size channels to misrepresent), but the tension slider inverts intuitive mapping (value 0.85 → curveBundle.beta=0.15, so higher tension yields less bundling) and data joins lack key functions, though the static-only render makes the latter benign.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.stress_test_note: The tension slider fires un-throttled `input` events that synchronously redraw all 80+ bundled paths via `linkSelection.attr('d', line)` on every pixel of movement with no RAF or debounce; all other interaction patterns (hover, no transitions, no cross-view dispatch) are clean.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.cognitive_load_note: Resting state reads as a dense hairball (~80 edges crossing the center at tension 0.85), but the hover interaction redeems it by fading unrelated links and applying directional blue/orange encoding, making individual dependency traces immediately clear; single view, restrained 2-color scheme, and no animation avoid other cognitive load risks.
